Question:
Consider the polynomial \[ \begin{aligned} P(x) &= \prod_{k=0}^{10}\left(x^{2^k} + 2^k\right) \\ &= (x+1)(x^2+2)(x^4+4) \\ &\quad \cdots (x^{1024}+1024). \end{aligned} \]

The coefficient of \(x^{2012}\) is equal to \(2^a.\) What is \(a?\)
